from itertools import permutations

# Define the size of the chessboard
n = 11

# Generate all possible permutations of columns for the queens
for p in permutations(range(n)):
    # Assume this permutation is a solution
    is_solution = True
    
    # Check if any two queens attack each other
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i + 1, n):
            # If two queens are in the same column or diagonal, this permutation is not a solution
            if p[i] == p[j] or abs(p[i] - p[j]) == j - i:
                is_solution = False
                break
        
        # If we've already found a reason why this permutation is not a solution, stop checking
        if not is_solution:
            break
    
    # If this permutation is a solution, print it and stop
    if is_solution:
        print(p)
        break
